newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes down 7.2 vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes down 7.2 vs dollar.

text.p: BOGOTA, May 5 Reuter - Colombia's peso closed 7.2 pesos down against the dollar at 1079 on the back of speculation about an imminent drop in interest rates, interbank traders said.
The rate is the lowest since February 24, dealers said.

Demand from industry was thin but banks bought greenbacks heavily in anticipation of a central bank announcement --widely expected Tuesday -- to cut the interest rate on 90-day treasury bills from the current 24 percent to 22 percent, market dealers said.
Dealers reported 409 trades worth a total $168.1 million dollars. The peso opened at 1071 and sank to an intraday low of 1080.8.
